**BVDS** is an intervention code used within the Danish healthcare system, specifically denoting "Behandling i skole" (treatment in school) [^src1]. It is applied in the context of patient education initiatives for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1]. 

In the clinical quality databases coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), standardized codes are critical for tracking and comparing healthcare quality across regions. When documenting patient education for atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter, the primary code utilized is [[bfkb|BFKB]] (Patientuddannelse i atrieflimren og atrieflagren) [^src1]. To ensure comprehensive data collection on these educational interventions, the coding framework also incorporates **BVDS** alongside [[bqf-star|BQF*]] and [[bvdy-star|BVDY*]] [^src1].
